sw-oauth-client.title: OAuth applications
sw-oauth-client.description: Register public applications for browser login with PKCE. Applications configured on the server are managed in the server configuration, not here.
sw-oauth-client.permissionsHint: After approval, an application acts with the approving user's current permissions. Registering an application does not grant access by itself. Use integrations for server-to-server access.
sw-oauth-client.name: Application name
sw-oauth-client.clientIdHelp: Use this ID with the authorization code grant and S256 PKCE. No client secret is needed.
sw-oauth-client.redirectHelp: One URL per line, up to 20 URLs (2048 characters each). Use HTTPS, or HTTP with 127.0.0.1 or [::1]. No credentials, fragments or wildcards. Loopback ports may vary; the remaining URL must match exactly.
sw-oauth-client.activeHelp: While disabled, this application cannot request, refresh or use tokens. Re-enabling it allows unexpired tokens to work again.
sw-oauth-client.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? This prevents the application from signing in and using its existing tokens.
sw-oauth-client.loadError: Could not load applications. Please try again.
sw-oauth-client.saveError: Could not save the application. Check the name and redirect URLs, and try again.
sw-oauth-client.deleteError: Could not delete the application. Please try again.
